data.why: the repo bundles all the .mat receptive-field/stimulation data and the stim_results.xlsx table it reads at startup; no uploads are needed.

goals: locate an electrode on the 3D brain reconstruction and identify its anatomical region
compare an electrode's receptive field across different acoustic/phonological feature models (spectrogram, onset, peak rate, phonological features, pitch)
assess how well a model explains an electrode's response by reading its correlation value
switch the color map between anatomy and correlation strength to find regions with strong speech encoding
view electrical stimulation results for an electrode and relate them to perceptual/hallucination effects reported during stimulation mapping
restrict the view to the temporal lobe to inspect stimulation sites more precisely

review.summary: The goal and phases match what the README and paper say the viewer is for, coverage of the planned goals is complete, and the screens I opened mostly back the nodes, with one wrong citation for the PNG download. File it after these fixes: describe selection as a click instead of the headless-browser press-and-release workaround, correct the hover and view wording, and add an explicit task comparing encoding across anatomical subfields.
